structured_output.thesis: This is the first-deployed coin (the canonical one) among several same-minute 'Mysterious Internet Money' launches. It has broad early participation: 621 unique buyers, 5.9x h1 turnover, and a few smart and KOL wallets. It is about 70% of the way through the pump.fun curve. Doubling from about $24k to about $48k is roughly migration territory, which is plausible if the source tweet keeps spreading. Heavy bundler and bot activity, a price already off its ATH, and pressure from copycats keep the odds modest. It ranks above a typical pool coin.
